scope: Sources for the 2026-11-26 review only; no change to canonical equation sources or model approval gates.
policy: Verification levels are source specific. Working-paper and published versions have separate locators. Project-specific algebra is identified as a derivation, not attributed verbatim to a paper.

items.authors: Finn E. Kydland; Edward C. Prescott
items.title: Time to Build and Aggregate Fluctuations
items.locator: Opening page, printed p.1345, abstract and Introduction
items.supports: Construction lags and stochastic technology/information coexist in an equilibrium growth model.
items.does_not_support: Does not validate LC parameters, LC futures structure, or any current repository numerical result.

items.authors: Olivier Jean Blanchard; Charles M. Kahn
items.title: The Solution of Linear Difference Models under Rational Expectations
items.locator: University-hosted scanned article; PDF pages 2-3 inspected; no complete text extraction
items.supports: Classical solution and determinacy framework for linear rational-expectations systems.
items.does_not_support: Not a proof of global nonlinear equilibrium existence, invariant domains, or LC identification.

items.title: On the Behaviour of Commodity Prices
items.locator: Section 1.1, printed pp.5-6, assumptions, inventory optimality, clearing and stationary rational-expectations definition
items.supports: Stochastic competitive storage, nonnegative inventories, price-function expectations and commodity-price nonlinearity.
items.does_not_support: Does not imply every observed persistence pattern is explained; no LC risk-sharing formula or Chinese monthly calibration.

items.title: Hedging Pressure and Futures Price Movements in a General Equilibrium Model
items.locator: Printed pp.411-413, abstract and introduction; PDF cover is an additional page
items.supports: Partial-equilibrium hedging-pressure implications do not automatically survive general equilibrium; trading participation changes risk sharing.
items.does_not_support: Does not imply all GE risk premia vanish or prove the current LC formula invalid within its explicitly limited PE assumptions.

items.title: Solving Dynamic General Equilibrium Models Using a Second-Order Approximation to the Policy Function
items.publication: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
items.locator: Printed pp.755-756, Introduction; approximation jointly in states and shock scale
items.supports: Standard perturbation certainty equivalence and second-order risk corrections under the paper's smooth-model assumptions.
items.does_not_support: Does not make all affine finite-risk projection policies risk-free, or guarantee that second order resolves LC financial-shock responses.

items.title: On the effects of rare disasters and uncertainty shocks for risk premia in non-linear DSGE models

open_version.title: How non-Gaussian shocks affect risk premia in non-linear DSGE models
open_version.publication: Bank of England Working Paper No. 417

items.locator: Working Paper 417, sections 4.1 and 4.3, printed pp.12-16; equations 12,17,18 and propositions 3-4; do not reuse these page numbers for the journal version
items.supports: Risk-level corrections versus time-varying risk premia at second/third order in conventional deterministic-steady-state perturbation.
items.does_not_support: The LC sigma-squared-times-state calculation is this review's derivation, not a quoted theorem for LC; not a universal ban on first-degree finite-risk projection.

items.authors: Ivar Ekeland; Delphine Lautier; Bertrand Villeneuve
items.title: Hedging pressure and speculation in commodity markets
items.locator: Author manuscript sections 3.3-3.4, printed pp.6-8; holdings equations 8-10 and clearing before equation 13
items.supports: Inventory and procurement hedges plus risk-bearing positions; joint physical/futures clearing and hedging pressure.
items.does_not_support: Does not automatically establish the LC infinite-horizon rolling-entry extension, variable macro discounting, or empirical price-discovery dominance.

items.authors: Viral V. Acharya; Lars A. Lochstoer; Tarun Ramadorai
items.title: Limits to arbitrage and hedging: Evidence from commodity markets
items.locator: Published abstract/introduction; early author version abstract and introduction. No journal equation numbers certified.
items.supports: Limited speculative risk capacity links hedging costs to real commodity decisions and spot prices.
items.does_not_support: No direct LC calibration or claim that current LC finite-risk parameters are microfounded; early and final empirical samples must not be mixed.

items.authors: Gary Koop; M. Hashem Pesaran; Simon M. Potter
items.title: Impulse response analysis in nonlinear multivariate models
items.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record; no full-text equation locator certified
items.supports: Generalized impulse responses as a framework for nonlinear dynamics, persistence and asymmetric effects.
items.does_not_support: Does not validate the repository's exact paired estimator, its simulation counts, policy accuracy or actual empirical inference.

items.title: Shocks and Frictions in US Business Cycles: A Bayesian DSGE Approach
items.locator: AEA article abstract and citation record
items.supports: Example of estimated structural shocks, frictions and business-cycle-source analysis.
items.does_not_support: Seven shocks and Bayesian estimation are not definitional requirements of DSGE; does not validate LC identification.

items.title: Dynare 7.2 Reference Manual: The model file
items.locator: Sections 4.12.1 Perfect foresight and 4.13.1 Computing the stochastic solution; stoch_simul and IRF descriptions
items.supports: Distinction between perfect-foresight paths and stochastic solution; IRFs, moments and correlated-shock decomposition conventions.
items.does_not_support: Calling stoch_simul or plotting an IRF is not independently sufficient evidence that an economic model is closed or empirically valid.
